A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same recovery-based AI-image detection work. Their complete main text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–E support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original detection experiments, ablations in Tables 1–3, and a 100-question human evaluation with 72.33% mean accuracy in Section 4.4.

after.justification: v2 retains the original detection experiments, ablations and human-evaluation outcomes, including the results in Tables 1–3 and Section 4.4.

M1.justification: The masking-and-recovery procedure, discrepancy scores, LoRA alignment, surrogate model and decision rule are unchanged. The mathematical correction in the diffusion preliminaries does not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both retain the same LAION-based real-image coverage and Guided Diffusion, LDM, GLIDE, DALL-E and DALL-E 3 generated images. The paired DALL-E 3 dataset and human-evaluation coverage already appear in v1.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same six baseline configurations: three trained-network variants, ResNet50-Layer1 and Xception-Block2 patch classifiers, and Freq-spec/CycleGAN. No comparator is added, removed or substantively revised.

E3.justification: Both retain the same white-box and black-box settings, generator sampling configurations, AP/AUROC/FPR95 metrics, threshold selection and 100-question human-evaluation procedure. No experimental protocol revision is reported.

E4.justification: The fine-tuning ablation, surrogate/target comparisons, score and mask analyses, score distributions, and qualitative examples are unchanged in Tables 2–3, Figures 3–7 and the appendices.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting practices are unchanged, including the human respondents' accuracy summary and range. No experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals or significance tests are added or removed.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3, plotted findings and human-study results match. Table 1 retains 86.61 mAP for the proposed method and 82.30 for Xception-Block2; Section 4.4 retains 72.33% mean human accuracy.

T1.justification: Before Eq. (3), v2 corrects the cumulative coefficient from product_{s=1}^t alpha_t to product_{s=1}^t alpha_s. This fixes a mathematical indexing error. The likelihood-gap hypothesis and Appendix A's assumptions, bounds and proofs are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about API-only recovery-based detection, an efficient distribution-aligned surrogate, generalizability and a 4.31-point mAP advantage.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning distribution alignment, PSNR sensitivity, mask coverage and human detection difficulty remain unchanged. Appendix A retains the same detectability discussion; no substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added.

D1.justification: v2 adds a public-code statement and the HaoyueBaiZJU/genai-detect repository address to the abstract. Existing implementation information, including PyTorch 2.3.1 and RTX A6000 in Appendix C, is unchanged. Repository contents and usability are not established by the PDFs.

R1.justification: The same 52 references and related-work positioning are retained. Changed citation-page locators for references 13 and 14 reflect text reflow rather than changes to cited research.

P1.justification: A short code-availability sentence is added to the abstract, and the version header is updated. The remaining prose, terminology, section order and narrative structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 2, 4 and 5 are reduced in size, and surrounding text reflows. Both retain the same seven figures and three tables with unchanged graphical content, captions and table organization. The appendix pages are visually identical.

improvement.justification: Correcting the cumulative diffusion coefficient removes a mathematical error, and the new code pointer improves reproducibility documentation. These are limited gains: the method, experimental evidence and appendices remain unchanged, and repository contents or usability cannot be verified from the PDFs.
